_doc: R33-class duplicate-key guard for this plugin, shipped as a plugin hook (round-35 panel's preferred placement over machine-wide). Fires on Edit|Write|MultiEdit of .json files, warns Claude via exit 2 + stderr on duplicate keys. Fail-open on every internal error path. See tools/check_json_dup_keys_hook.py for the wrapper and CHANGELOG 1.12.0 for the panel that chose this over ~/.claude/settings.json.
_doc_sessionstart_r58: R58/R86 update notifier, exec form (command + args; measured working on claude 2.1.268, 8/8 sessions). Two things in one JSON: (1) a ONE-TIME note when the plugin's VERSION changed since the last session (Claude Code updated it, or `update_check.py --apply` did), quoting the CHANGELOG section shipped inside the plugin; (2) the kit's weekly release check - one GET to api.github.com at most every 168 h (stamp outside the tree, ETag, 3 s timeout, backoff, kill switches MODEL_ORCH_UPDATE_CHECK=0 / NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER / CI) - because Claude Code's own auto-update is OFF by default for third-party marketplaces, so without this nobody learns of a release. The notice names the ONE command that applies it (`update_check.py --apply`, which runs `claude plugin update` on this install path). Both `systemMessage` (user-visible) and `additionalContext` (model-visible) are emitted; #12151 is why both. Timeout 15 s: the weekly week pays two short GETs, every other session start returns in well under a second.
